text: Transportation Services is requesting authority to prohibit right-turn-on-red movements for northbound and southbound motor vehicle traffic on Jane Street at Pritchard Avenue. This prohibition is recommended to improve safety of the intersection for people walking, cycling, taking transit, or driving. As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Jane Street, City Council approval of this report is required.

City Council on December 15, 16 and 17, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council prohibit northbound right-turns on a red signal at all times on Jane Street at Pritchard Avenue (north intersection). 2. City Council prohibit southbound right-turns on a red signal at all times on Jane Street at Pritchard Avenue (south intersection).
